mn17:3.1: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu aññataraṃ vanapatthaṃ upanissāya viharati;
mn17:3.2: tassa taṃ vanapatthaṃ upanissāya viharato anupaṭṭhitā c' eva sati na upaṭṭhāti, asamāhitañ-ca cittaṃ na samādhiyati, aparikkhīṇā ca āsavā na parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, ananuppattañ-ca anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ nānupāpuṇāti,
